commitments.speaker: Ashish Mangal (Managing Director)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: NSE/BSE Corporate Filing: Transcript of Earnings Conference Call held on May 15, 2024 for Q4 & FY24
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Looking ahead into FY25 and FY26, with our strong order book and expanding presence in railway and high-voltage transmission, we guide for annual revenue growth exceeding 15% with disciplined working capital.
commitments.commitment: Annual revenue expansion exceeding 15% YoY with disciplined working capital
commitments.statusExplanation: FY25 revenue expanded by 16.73%, surpassing the 15.0% guidance floor.

commitments.speaker: Ashish Mangal (Managing Director)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: DYCL 17th Annual Report FY 2023-24, Management Discussion and Analysis, pg. 42
commitments.sourceExcerpt: The company has undertaken capex of ₹35 Crore to set up a dedicated manufacturing line for solar cables and MV power cables at the Reengus plant, targeted for commercial commissioning by Q3 FY25.
commitments.commitment: Commercial commissioning of dedicated solar and MV power cable manufacturing line at Reengus plant by Q3 FY25
commitments.actualMetricValue: Commercial production commenced on December 18, 2024 at Reengus unit
commitments.statusExplanation: The Reengus manufacturing line was commissioned and announced on December 18, 2024, fulfilling the Q3 FY25 deadline.

commitments.speaker: Murari Lal Poddar (Chief Financial Officer)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: Investor Presentation Q2 FY25 filed with BSE/NSE, Slide 14 Financial Outlook
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Given the current copper and aluminium price stabilization and pass-through contracts, we maintain guidance of operating EBITDA margin in the range of 10.5% to 11.5% for H2 FY25.
commitments.commitment: Maintain operating EBITDA margin in 10.5% to 11.5% band across H2 FY25
commitments.actualMetricValue: 10.82% (H2 FY25 EBITDA of ₹49.1 Cr on Revenue of ₹453.8 Cr)
commitments.statusExplanation: H2 FY25 operating margin was 10.82%, landing squarely within the guided 10.5% - 11.5% band.

commitments.speaker: Samir Seksaria (Chief Financial Officer)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: TCS Earnings Conference Call Transcript Q4 FY24, April 12, 2024, pg. 6
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Our aspirational and guided operating margin band remains 26% to 28%. While headwinds from wage hikes exist in H1, our medium-term target for FY25 is to exit the year within or near the 26-28% corridor.
commitments.commitment: Deliver operating EBIT margin within or near the 26% to 28% band for FY25
commitments.actualMetricValue: 24.4% (Full year FY25 consolidated operating margin was 24.4%; Q4 exit was 24.6%)
commitments.statusExplanation: FY25 EBIT margin of 24.4% fell 160 bps short of the 26.0% lower bound of the guided band due to muted discretionary IT spend.

commitments.speaker: Milind Lakkad (Chief Human Resources Officer)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: TCS Annual Report 2023-24, Human Capital Section, pg. 78
commitments.sourceExcerpt: We plan to onboard approximately 40,000 fresh engineering graduates from campuses in India across FY2024-25 as part of our talent pyramid pipeline.
commitments.commitment: Onboard approximately 40,000 fresh engineering graduates in FY25
commitments.actualMetricValue: 42,000 fresh campus graduates onboarded in FY25
commitments.statusExplanation: TCS onboarded 42,000 campus graduates during FY25, meeting and slightly exceeding the 40,000 guidance.

commitments.speaker: Mukesh D. Ambani (Chairman & Managing Director)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: Address by Mukesh D. Ambani at 46th Annual General Meeting of Reliance Industries Limited, August 28, 2023, pg. 8
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Jio’s True 5G rollout will be complete across the length and breadth of India by December 2023, making it the fastest 5G rollout of this scale globally.
commitments.commitment: Complete nationwide True 5G rollout across India by December 2023
commitments.actualMetricValue: Pan-India True 5G network rollout completed in December 2023 with 90M+ 5G subscribers
commitments.statusExplanation: Jio achieved nationwide 5G standalone network coverage by December 2023 as promised.

commitments.speaker: Isha Ambani (Executive Director, Reliance Retail Ventures)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: RIL Annual Report 2022-23, Strategic Review: Reliance Retail, pg. 52
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Reliance Retail targets adding over 2,500 new stores and scaling gross square footage above 70 million sq. ft. in FY24.
commitments.commitment: Add over 2,500 new retail stores and surpass 70 million sq. ft. footprint in FY24
commitments.actualMetricValue: 2,707 new stores opened; total operational retail area expanded to 79.1 million sq. ft.
commitments.statusExplanation: Reliance Retail opened 2,707 stores in FY24, comfortably exceeding the 2,500 new stores guidance.

commitments.speaker: Sashidhar Jagdishan (Managing Director & CEO)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: HDFC Bank Earnings Call Transcript Q4 FY24, April 20, 2024, pg. 9
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Post-merger, our credit-to-deposit ratio elevated to 110%. Our conscious strategy over FY25 is to grow deposits faster than advances and bring down the CD ratio towards the pre-merger corridor below 100% and ultimately 85-90%.
commitments.commitment: Reduce credit-deposit (CD) ratio below 100% in FY25 via deposit mobilization
commitments.actualMetricValue: 98.2% (Deposits grew 15.1% YoY to ₹24.8 lakh Cr, advances grew 6.5%, CD ratio reduced to 98.2%)
commitments.statusExplanation: Credit-deposit ratio reduced from 110.5% to 98.2% by March 31, 2025, breaking below the 100% ceiling.

commitments.speaker: Kaizad Bharucha (Deputy Managing Director)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: HDFC Bank Annual Report 2023-24, Distribution Network Expansion, pg. 34
commitments.sourceExcerpt: We plan to open 1,000 to 1,200 new branch locations in FY25 to deepen our semi-urban and rural deposit franchise.
commitments.commitment: Open 1,000 to 1,200 new branch locations in FY25
commitments.actualMetricValue: 912 new branches opened in FY25 (Total branch network reached 9,092)
commitments.comparisonMethod: ACTUAL_VALUE vs TARGET_RANGE (912 opened vs 1,000 target floor)
commitments.statusExplanation: HDFC Bank opened 912 new branches (91.2% of the 1,000 floor target), falling slightly short of the guided minimum 1,000 branch additions.

commitments.speaker: Manoj Jain (Chairman & Managing Director)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: Transcript of Analyst/Investor Conference Call held on May 20, 2024, BSE/NSE Filing, pg. 4
commitments.sourceExcerpt: For FY 2024-25, we project revenue growth of approximately 15% YoY with EBITDA margins sustained around 23% to 25%.
commitments.commitment: Deliver approximately 15% YoY revenue growth in FY25
commitments.actualMetricValue: 14.95% (Revenue reached ₹23,200 Cr vs ₹20,180 Cr in FY24, +14.95% YoY growth)
commitments.statusExplanation: FY25 revenue grew by 14.95%, matching the 15% guidance within standard rounding tolerance.

commitments.speaker: Manoj Jain (Chairman & Managing Director)
commitments.sourceDocumentReference: BEL Earnings Call Transcript Q1 FY25, July 29, 2024, pg. 7
commitments.sourceExcerpt: Our order inflow guidance for the full financial year FY25 is targeted at ₹25,000 Crore, backed by upcoming QRSAM, naval radars, and electronic warfare contracts.
commitments.commitment: Secure full-year FY25 order inflow of at least ₹25,000 Crore
commitments.actualMetricValue: ₹25,930 Crore in new order inflows during FY25 (Order book reached ₹76,200 Cr)
commitments.statusExplanation: BEL secured ₹25,930 Crore in new orders in FY25, exceeding the ₹25,000 Crore guidance.
